title: Jacob Mathew v. State of Punjab

content.caseIdentity: Jacob Mathew v. State of Punjab, (2005) 6 SCC 1 (Supreme Court of India)
content.holding: Affirmed the Bolam test for medical negligence in India. Held that an error of judgment or failure to cure does not constitute negligence. For criminal negligence under Section 304A IPC, gross negligence is mandatory.
content.relevance: Leading Indian authority on medical and professional negligence, shielding doctors from frivolous civil and criminal litigation.
